study type: Secondary analysis of cross-sectional analytical study
cohort: Mothers who gave birth at three tertiary hospitals in South-East Nigeria
finding: There was a significant decrease in tertiary-hospital based birth rate during the COVID-19 pandemic compared to the pre-pandemic period.
mod_finding: More mothers gave birth via vaginal delivery during the COVID-19 period compared to the pre-pandemic period.
cross-section timing: October to December 2019 (Pre-COVID) and October to December 2020 (COVID era)
